leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure Vue Router to implement lazy loading for route components
Construct dynamic import statements for route components using Webpack's code splitting
Apply lazy loading to specific routes in a Vue application's router configuration
Initialize route components only when their corresponding routes are accessed
Manipulate the router configuration to replace static imports with dynamic imports
Integrate lazy loading patterns into an existing Vue Router setup
Render route components asynchronously to improve initial bundle size
